name: sidebar-clear-icon-hint-and-hotkey
description: The divider above the ungrouped rows is a bare line with an archive icon at its end - no TABS label, no CLEAR text. Hovering the icon shows the sidebar hint with its label and the clearTabs chord, read off the live bindings map PushSidebarBindings hands the page. Cmd+Shift+K then archives the rows the same way a click does, so the header (rendered only while there is something to clear) disappears.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('.sechdr'); if (!h) { return 'no-header'; } const b = h.querySelector('.sechdrclear'); if (h.textContent.trim() !== '') { return 'text:' + h.textContent.trim(); } if (!b || !b.querySelector('svg')) { return 'no-icon'; } return 'line+icon'; })()

actions.note: the icon at the divider's right end - it is opacity 0 until the sidebar is really hovered, and the synthetic pointerover below cannot do that

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.sechdrclear'); if (!b) { return 'no-button'; } b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerover', {bubbles: true})); return 'hovered'; })()

actions.note: clearTabs: archives the space's ungrouped rows
the header only renders while there are tabs to clear

assertions.desc: No label text, an SVG icon in the clear button
the clear icon was found and hovered
The hint carries the icon's label
The hint names Cmd+Shift+K off the live bindings map
Cmd+Shift+K archived the rows, the header went with them
